name: Space priority
description: Built-in unmeasured CPU HEVC starter: x265 medium, CRF 28. Higher CRF requests stronger compression with more quality loss than the other CPU HEVC starters; source format and dimensions remain unchanged. CRF 28 is x265's upstream default, not a guarantee for camera originals. Benchmark representative footage when possible. Quality, output size and encoding time are unknown. No fallback: choose another preset explicitly if preflight rejects this encoder or format.
